description: Act 6: queued when Mara pressed Tell the ground at 12:05 with the link down. leaves_at is the next contact; the session never waits for it. Illustrative only: not seed data.

lines: Tomas Lind needs help at the airlock. Eye injury or something in the eye.
Air safe. Tomas Lind responding. No heavy bleeding. Eye injury, chemical or dust in the eye.

Steps done: Do not rub the eye. Chemical, dust or grit in the eye: hold the eye open and rinse with lots of clean water at once, for at least 20 minutes. In weightlessness, water and dust float. Use the onboard eye wash set. Until it is ready, rinse with a drink bag and soak up the water with towels.
Crew called at 12:02. Ilya Brandt helping.
